I will plant improved maize seed on this small plot because I can watch it closely, and when I put a little fertilizer and some manure there, I usually see better cobs than with local seed alone. I own this land, so I will carry manure from home and add a small amount of chemical fertilizer, but I will not spend money on pesticide or irrigation because this season I depend on the rains and I must keep cash for the other plots. Most of the work I will do with my family, the same as I did last season, and I will not hire labor for only 0.10 hectare.
